   217|
   218|// Bracketed tag convention on ORC stories: [SPIKE], [INVESTIGATION], [POC], etc.
   219|// The tag reliably marks Tech Investigation work regardless of the story's current
   220|// workflow state — per doc §5, Tech Investigation is defined by the nature of the
   221|// work, not the Jira status it ends up in.
   222|const SPIKE_TAG = /\[[^\]]*\b(spike|investigation|investigate|feasibility|poc|proof\s+of\s+concept)\b[^\]]*\]/i
   223|
   224|const DISCOVERY_KEYWORDS = /discovery|research|customer\s*research|user need|market analysis/i

   227|/**
   228| * Result of classifying a single story against phase-placement rules. This is
   229| * the single source of truth the cell-level and per-story paths both call;
   230| * keeping them aligned is what guarantees `cell.placement.ruleFired` and
   231| * `story.ruleFired` stay in sync.
   232| *
   233| * `evidence` captures rule-specific detail (the spike bracket matched, which
   234| * discovery keywords fired) so the client can surface "why" without
   235| * re-inspecting story summaries.
   236| */
   237|export interface StoryRuleClassification {
   238|  phaseId: PhaseId
   239|  ruleFired: PlacementRule

   242|    discoveryKeywordsMatched?: string[]

   246|export function classifyStoryRule(
   247|  story: WindowStoryActivity,
   248|  effortType: EffortType | null,
   249|): StoryRuleClassification {
   250|  const status = story.status
   251|  const summary = story.summary
   252|
   253|  // 1. Tag override — bracketed [SPIKE]/[INVESTIGATION]/[POC] tags route to Tech
   254|  //    Investigation regardless of workflow state.
   255|  const spikeMatch = summary.match(SPIKE_TAG)
   256|  if (spikeMatch) {
   257|    return {
   258|      phaseId: 'tech-invest',
   259|      ruleFired: 'spike-tag',
   260|      evidence: { spikeTagMatched: spikeMatch[0] },
   261|    }
   262|  }
   263|
   264|  // 2. Terminal statuses — a story that reached Done or Won't Do during the window
   265|  //    still consumed capacity and belongs on the grid (doc §13 + user guidance:
   266|  //    work that crossed the half-day floor counts, even if it ended in Won't Do).
   267|  //    Default to Delivery & QA as the most common producing phase; the user
   268|  //    reclassifies edge cases during end-of-window reconciliation.
   269|  if (status === 'Done' || status === "Won't Do" || status === "won't do") {
   270|    return { phaseId: 'delivery-qa', ruleFired: 'terminal-status', evidence: {} }
   271|  }
   272|
   273|  // 3. Delivery & QA active statuses
   274|  if (status === 'In Progress' || status === 'In Review' || status === 'Ready for QA' || status === 'In QA') {
   275|    return { phaseId: 'delivery-qa', ruleFired: 'active-delivery', evidence: {} }
   276|  }
   277|
   278|  // 4. Definition statuses (In Refinement folds in here — the spike check at the
   279|  //    top already caught any feasibility work that happened to be in refinement).
   280|  if (status === 'Ready' || status === 'Ready for Development' || status === 'In Refinement') {
   281|    return { phaseId: 'definition', ruleFired: 'refinement', evidence: {} }
   282|  }
   283|
   284|  // 5. Backlog — heuristic-based
   285|  if (status === 'Backlog') {
   286|    if (effortType === 'ux-debt') {
   287|      return { phaseId: 'uxr-uxd', ruleFired: 'ux-debt-backlog', evidence: {} }
   288|    }
   289|    const kwMatches = summary.match(DISCOVERY_KEYWORDS_GLOBAL)
   290|    if (kwMatches && kwMatches.length > 0) {
   291|      // Deduplicate matched keywords case-insensitively, preserving first-seen casing.
   292|      const seen = new Set<string>()
   293|      const kws: string[] = []
   294|      for (const m of kwMatches) {
   295|        const lc = m.toLowerCase()
   296|        if (!seen.has(lc)) { seen.add(lc); kws.push(m) }
   297|      }
   298|      return {
   299|        phaseId: 'discovery',
   300|        ruleFired: 'discovery-keyword-backlog',
   301|        evidence: { discoveryKeywordsMatched: kws },
   302|      }
   303|    }
   304|    return { phaseId: 'tech-invest', ruleFired: 'fallback-tech-invest', evidence: {} }
   305|  }
   306|
   307|  // Unknown status — fall back to tech-invest
   308|  return { phaseId: 'tech-invest', ruleFired: 'fallback-tech-invest', evidence: {} }
   309|}

   336|export function detectAlerts(
   337|  cells: TetrisCell[],
   338|  effortTypes: EffortTypeMap,
   339|  windows: TetrisWindow[],
   340|): TetrisAlert[] {
   341|  const alerts: TetrisAlert[] = []
   342|  const currentWindow = windows.find(w => w.relation === 'current')
   343|  const pastWindow = windows.find(w => w.relation === 'past')
   344|
   345|  if (!currentWindow) return alerts
   346|
   347|  const currentCells = cells.filter(c => c.windowId === currentWindow.id)
   348|
   349|  // empty-discovery: no cells with phaseId 'discovery' in current window
   350|  const discoveryCells = currentCells.filter(c => c.phaseId === 'discovery')
   351|  if (discoveryCells.length === 0) {
   352|    alerts.push({
   353|      type: 'empty-discovery',
   354|      message: 'No epics in Product Discovery for the current window \u2014 PM may be pulled into delivery mindshare.',
   355|      severity: 'warning',
   356|      windowId: currentWindow.id,
   357|      phaseId: 'discovery',
   358|    })
   359|  }
   360|
   361|  // mpi14-collapsed: fewer than 2 distinct Jira epics under MPI-14 in current
   362|  // window. Scoped to Jira cells — the Excel often breaks MPI-14 into many
   363|  // imported cells by design (one per dev-week/workstream), so mixing imports
   364|  // in would suppress the signal the check is meant to raise about Jira
   365|  // collapsing all sustaining work into a single catch-all epic.
   366|  const mpi14JiraEpics = new Set<string>()
   367|  for (const cell of currentCells) {
   368|    if (cell.source === 'jira' && cell.mpiKey === 'MPI-14') {
   369|      mpi14JiraEpics.add(cell.epicKey)
   370|    }
   371|  }
   372|  if (mpi14JiraEpics.size > 0 && mpi14JiraEpics.size < 2) {
   373|    alerts.push({
   374|      type: 'mpi14-collapsed',
   375|      message: 'MPI-14 SEM work may be collapsed in Jira \u2014 consider breaking out distinct workstreams.',
   376|      severity: 'warning',
   377|      windowId: currentWindow.id,
   378|    })
   379|  }
   380|
   381|  // overloaded-delivery: current window delivery-qa has >8 distinct Jira
   382|  // epics. Scoped to Jira so imported dev-row stacks don't inflate the count;
   383|  // the §9 ceiling is about "concurrent efforts" = distinct workstreams with
   384|  // active story activity, which maps onto Jira epics in Delivery.
   385|  const deliveryJiraEpics = new Set<string>()
   386|  for (const cell of currentCells) {
   387|    if (cell.source === 'jira' && cell.phaseId === 'delivery-qa') {
   388|      deliveryJiraEpics.add(cell.epicKey)
   389|    }
   390|  }
   391|  if (deliveryJiraEpics.size > 8) {
   392|    alerts.push({
   393|      type: 'overloaded-delivery',
   394|      message: `Delivery & QA has ${deliveryJiraEpics.size} concurrent Jira epics \u2014 exceeds the 5\u20138 capacity ceiling.`,
   395|      severity: 'warning',
   396|      windowId: currentWindow.id,
   397|      phaseId: 'delivery-qa',
   398|    })
   399|  }
   400|
   401|  // stale-epic: a Jira epic that had story activity in the previous window
   402|  // has no activity this window and is not already closed. Scoped to Jira
   403|  // cells only — imported cells have synthesized per-Excel-row keys that
   404|  // never match across windows by construction, and manual cards aren't
   405|  // part of the stale-activity signal.
   406|  if (pastWindow) {
   407|    const pastJiraCells = cells.filter(c => c.windowId === pastWindow.id && c.source === 'jira')
   408|    const currentJiraCells = currentCells.filter(c => c.source === 'jira')
   409|    const pastEpicKeys = new Set(pastJiraCells.map(c => c.epicKey))
   410|    const currentEpicKeys = new Set(currentJiraCells.map(c => c.epicKey))
   411|
   412|    const terminalStatuses = new Set(['Done', "Won't Do", "won't do"])
   413|
   414|    for (const epicKey of pastEpicKeys) {
   415|      if (currentEpicKeys.has(epicKey)) continue
   416|
   417|      // Check if all stories for this epic in the past window are terminal
   418|      const pastStoriesForEpic = pastJiraCells
   419|        .filter(c => c.epicKey === epicKey)
   420|        .flatMap(c => c.stories)
   421|      const allTerminal = pastStoriesForEpic.length > 0 &&
   422|        pastStoriesForEpic.every(s => terminalStatuses.has(s.status))
   423|
   424|      if (!allTerminal) {
   425|        alerts.push({
   426|          type: 'stale-epic',
   427|          message: `${epicKey} appeared last window but has no activity this window \u2014 may be stalled.`,
   428|          severity: 'warning',
   429|          epicKey,
   430|        })
   431|      }
   432|    }
   433|  }
   434|
   435|  return alerts
   436|}

   438|// ── Summary-based MPI fallback ──────────────────────────────────────────────
   439|
   440|// Matches "[MPI-14]" or "MPI-14" appearing anywhere in the summary. The
   441|// bracketed form is the team convention; the bare form is a permissive
   442|// fallback for epics that still embed the reference without brackets.
   443|const SUMMARY_MPI_REF = /\bMPI-(\d+)\b/i
   444|
   445|export function extractMpiFromSummary(summary: string | null | undefined): string | null {
